slices.label: Local computation, bounded positive degree
slices.task: Answer consistent cluster-membership queries for an implicit (3+ε)-approximate clustering
assumptions: Unweighted signed complete graph represented by positive-edge graph
Randomized per-query probes; local space O((Δ/ε)polylog n)

yAxis.label: Probe ladder in Δ (per answered query)

parameters.coordinateConvention: Only the stated fixed ε or δ instance is colored; the table retains the theorem’s free parameters and output assumptions.

results.bound: O(Δ/ε) probes per local output query; O((Δ/ε)polylog n) local space
results.notes: Degree dependence prevents honest placement on an n-only exponent chart; LCA probes are not LOCAL rounds. Chart: Fix ε=1/4; O(Δ/ε) probes is in the poly(Δ) tier; local space is stated separately.

slices.label: Adjacency-matrix local cluster labels with additive error
slices.task: Return a consistent cluster label for queried vertex v
assumptions: Only pairwise similarity/matrix oracle; common random seed shared across vertex queries
(c,ε) means clustering cost at most c·OPT+εn²

yAxis.label: Probe ladder in Δ (per answered query)

results.bound: O(1/ε²) time; O(1/ε) after O(1/ε²) nonadaptive preprocessing
results.guarantee: With constant success, globally consistent clustering cost ≤4·OPT+εn²
results.notes: Expected factor 3 stated separately; 4 is the constant-success factor; labels consistent with shared random seed.

results.bound: poly(1/ε) per-label time after poly(1/ε) probes and 2^{poly(1/ε)} time preprocessing
results.notes: Pure additive error, with expensive preprocessing; different task guarantee from 3+ε multiplicative Pruned Pivot.

results.bound: Ω(1/(ε c²)) probes per label for c≥1 and ε∈(1/n,1/(100c))
results.guarantee: For a (c,ε) local clustering algorithm, even with ε-only preprocessing
results.notes: The 2020 WWW analysis clarifies this earlier proof only covers algorithms with deterministic per-vertex query budgets; its stronger adaptive global lower bound is separately cited.

results.bound: Ω(1/ε) adaptive probes per local query
results.guarantee: Necessary for any O(1) multiplicative plus εn² additive guarantee
results.notes: Restricts local matrix model; positive-degree neighbor access changes power.
